strings: Feels the days start to blur
Cleans a wound after an argument turned into bloodshed
Ends up trying to eat bark after days of scenting no prey
Climbs to the top of a tree, trying to get a better view of StarClan
Is being haunted by the screams of murdered cats
Is searching for a sparring partner
Tries to lick the mud out of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} pelt, to no avail
Is worried about whether {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} will find {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} way to StarClan
Is no longer fazed by the spooky landscape of the Dark Forest
